dedupe_keys.name: spark high resolution 5 s electricity data from 22 industrial machines and a pv system at kit campus north karlsruhe curated and raw

description: Long-term, high-rate electricity measurements from machines in an industrial production area. The KIT RADAR records say SPARK holds measurements from 22 industrial machines, including mills, lathes, chip presses and pumps, and one photovoltaic system at Campus North of the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, sampled every 5 seconds over one to seven years: voltages, currents, active and reactive power, harmonics, total harmonic distortion and frequency, stored as MACHINE/MEASUREMENT/VALUES_PER_YEAR folders of csv.xz files. The curated SPARK set is 76.2 GB and the unfiltered SPARK-Raw set 246.2 GB, both published in January 2026 as free downloadable tar archives under CC BY 4.0. The Scientific Data paper (28 February 2026) counts more than 74 billion data points, up to 190 quantities per device, and adds weather, electricity prices and emission factors. Coverage is one research campus production area in Germany. Caveats: a workshop and research setting, not a large plant, and the raw set needs cleaning. For simulation it gives second-scale machine loads and power quality for industrial demand flexibility, digital twins and grid disturbance studies. Related catalogue records include HIPE from the same group.
